verdict.rationale: The pack only gestures at an Acceptable Use Policy via a transparency-hub mention of 'Acceptable Use enforcement reporting' and system cards on risk areas, but contains no actual usage-policy text, prohibited-use list, commercial terms, or data-handling commitments in plain language. Missing for 10: the actual Usage Policy/Acceptable Use Policy content, explicit commercial-use terms, and data-handling/retention commitments written in plain language.
